title: Rabbit Gets Stuck in the Hoop, Capybara Brings a Melon 🍉
description:
The dunk... is technically complete. 🏀🍉 Bunny the rabbit jumps higher than anyone ever has, then gets stuck upside down in the hoop. Kapi the capybara has a melon.

Kapi in the League, Episode 2: Bunny's Big Dunk. A 3D animated basketball comedy about a very calm capybara, a very big bear (Bruno) and a very fast rabbit (Bunny), with Rico the parrot on the mic.

▶️ Start from Episode 1, Season Opener: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ULDSAqNZm8g
👉 Next episode: Bruno's Wall. Subscribe to Kapi's World so you don't miss it!
💬 Would you let go of the rim for a slice of melon? Tell us in the comments!

Made with AI-assisted animation tools. The characters and the story are original.

#Capybara #Basketball #FunnyAnimals #Shorts #Animation #KapiInTheLeague
